Table 3.2 illustrates the function of B vitamins as coenzymes, assisting in metabolizing carbohydrates, fat, and 
proteins, thus producing energy for body cells via the citric acid cycle. The citric acid cycle occurs in the cell 
mitochondria, also known as the cell’s powerhouse—this is where the final breakdown for carbohydrates, amino 
acids, and fatty acids occurs.
